items.title: MI5 chief warns of threats to UK from Russia, Iran and AI
items.summary: Sir Ken McCallum says operations to tackle terrorism and state threats are now roughly of an "equal scale".

items.title: Man killed by tiger at UK wildlife park pictured
items.summary: The man who was mauled to death by a tiger at Yorkshire Wildlife Park after entering its enclosure has been identified as William Chapman, Sky News understands.

items.title: MI5 chief warns against overstating Russian interference in Brexit vote
items.summary: It comes after Andy Burnham said Moscow had tried to interfere in the 2016 referendum.

items.title: Tech firms promise to take down AI platforms if British secret services show they are unsafe
items.summary: OpenAI and Anthropic have promised to take down their AIs if the British secret services show them they are unsafe - activating what some describe as a "kill switch".

items.title: Man killed in tiger attack identified as William Chapman
items.summary: A health and safety investigation is under way at Yorkshire Wildlife Park following the incident.

items.title: Adult victims of arson attack which also killed two children are named
items.summary: Two adults who died alongside two children following an arson attack at a home in Ireland have been named as Philip and Kim English.
